title: Internal board access stays within reviewed bot and account boundaries
description:
As an authorized user, I want bot boards visible only within their permitted scope so internal work remains isolated.

Proposed acceptance behavior for future implementation; not executable proof or a delivery claim.

```gherkin
Feature: Internal board access isolation
  Scenario: Read within an approved scope
    Given my membership and bot permissions allow access to an internal board
    When I request that board through the approved user or agent interface
    Then I can inspect the permitted issues and board identity
  Scenario: Guess an out-of-scope board identifier
    Given an internal board is outside the caller's permitted scope
    When the caller requests or updates it using a guessed identifier
    Then no issue content is disclosed
    And no issue is changed
  Scenario: Access has been revoked
    Given a caller previously had access to an internal board
    And that access is revoked
    When the caller next requests or updates the board
    Then the request obeys the reviewed revocation contract
    And revoked access does not permit issue changes
```

Design/acceptance questions before implementation: Define board ownership and account placement, tenant membership versus bot authority, user/agent read and write policies, delegation, denial responses and revocation timing. Verify isolation for canonical S3 records, DynamoDB catalog queries and the shared UI. Keep credentials, IAM policy details and resource provisioning outside this filing request.
right_now_summary: The team is defining access rules to keep internal boards isolated and protected from unauthorized changes.
